profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: I am a senior software engineer with a broad range of experience in different aspects of the industry. I've worked on web (full stack) and mobile apps, big data/geospatial, and infrastructure. I came to software development from law. I practiced as a plaintiff-side attorney in California.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:

- Build data pipelines to transform public/private datasets into machine learning ready features
- Build and optimize machine learning models

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Build custom software to meet the needs of companies in the renewables and efficiency spaces. 

The skills listed below are a brief overview intended to give a general sense of what our company does.
 
- Javascript/React/React Native/Node/Firebase
- Python
- iOS/Swift
- SQL, NoSQL

- Systems architecture, designing solutions to client needs on both the macro and micro scales
 * data models
 * flow diagrams
 * specific sub-components
 * selecting the toolchain to fit the project

- Documentation of both internal and external processes
